craft_notes: Sthāyin: somewhere-makership; passion's part. Rows: settle then point. Read aloud: measured tread.

lines: It is making slight, elsewhere perfected, makings alone;
in this sense it settles; and now attention was paid
l4.sanskrit_cite: kiṃcitkartṛtvaṃ kiṃcidbhāgasiddhaye kvacid eva kartṛtvam ity atra arthe paryavasyati kvacid eva ca ity atra bhāge rāgatattvasya vyāpāraḥ
